limitations: Not installed in either standalone Drawing or Atlas app; bridge binary and descriptor exist only in a temporary Linux test project.
Caller supplies already-transformed raster-local path samples, byte-packed little-endian float64; full transformed mask creation is separate.
The test recomputes canonical Godot brush pixels before accepting the native wire, so it is a correctness witness rather than a standalone secure production adapter.
No native-call timing, full gesture performance gain, physical GPU memory, pointer-to-visible p95, Windows build, or standalone binary portability claim.
mode: isolated, opt-in Godot 4.8 beta 2 GDExtension scalar hard-brush sparse ABI
scope: Each run compares one crossing 4px brush to real DrawingEditSession.paint_path output, validates the complete 63-change sparse wire before staging one checked DrawingDocument revision, then checks undo/redo, hidden RGB, mask, erase, zero-alpha no-op, malformed inputs, and capacity bounds.
